name: chat-room
description: Local chat history, coordination threads, worktree conflict detection, and explicit idle-session wakeups for coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: A local chat room for humans, agents, and Git worktrees.
interface.longDescription: Gives every Git project a local, advisory chat room shared by humans, Codex sessions, Claude Code sessions, subagents, and linked worktrees. It mirrors local CLI histories read-only, opens manual or preemptive-conflict threads with stable references, keeps worktrees as independent #targets, and can start an explicitly tagged idle Codex turn.
defaultPrompt: List open coordination threads and path overlaps.
